found.finding: Four real returns-sheet fault lines (TAB MISSING, NOT READY, HEADER NOT CHECKED, RECORD NOT WRITTEN) were missing from the fault words.
Checks fed typed strings rather than the real messages.
found.fix: A check that every fault word is printed by the code, that start.py hands the block the lines, and that the block keeps its fixed shape.

found.finding: 9 of 11 fault words could be deleted from FAULT_WORDS and no check noticed, because the checks compared the list with itself.
found.fix: One check types the eleven words out and requires each to be named; a reviewer deleted and renamed each line on a scratch copy: all 22 versions turn red.

found.finding: A duplicate word added to FAULT_WORDS would pass the length check; a fault printed straight to the screen (ALARM) is not counted.
found.why: Harmless; coverage the same as before this round.
